items.stem: Which module starts the Agents path?

options.text: FND-104, the operating model for search, assistants, and agents.

items.stem: What is the prerequisite for ACC-104?
What does the Agent Building Competency certify?

options.text: That partner teams can design, build, govern, and operationalize production-grade Glean Agents.
That an individual has passed a written exam only.
That a partner may resell Glean licences.

items.stem: Which three modules make up the production discipline stage?

options.text: BLD-207 evaluation, BLD-208 governance, and SRV-204 debugging.

items.stem: Which capability area does the badge certify?

options.text: Persona-aligned agent design, including defining intents and configuring retrieval and guardrails.
